powergrid.component.property.power.summa: Maximum power that this component can handle for prolonged periods of time
powergrid.component.property.current.sum: Maximum current that this component can handle for prolonged periods of time
powergrid.component.property.voltage.sum: Maximum voltage that this component can handle
powergrid.component.property.label: Label
powergrid.component.property.tube_gain.s: Amplification factor, controls how strongly grid voltage influences plate current. Represents the maximum theoretical voltage gain the tube can provide
powergrid.component.property.tube_kg.sum: Plate current scaling factor. Mathematical constant that defines how effectively electrons are drawn from anode to cathode. Lower values allow the tube to handle bigger currents.
powergrid.component.property.tube_kg2.su: Screen-grid current scaling factor; controls how effectively the screen grid draws current. Lower values increase screen current at a given screen voltage.
powergrid.component.property.tube_kp.sum: Plate influence on cutoff, controls how sharply plate current is reduced as the grid goes negative
powergrid.component.property.tube_kvb.su: Knee voltage; shapes the low plate-voltage bend in the plate curves
powergrid.component.property.tube_ex.sum: Transfer exponent; controls the curvature of the plate curves (1.5 is close to the classic 3/2 power law)
powergrid.component.property.tube_satura: Maximum plate current that can pass through the tube before soft saturation clipping begins
powergrid.component.property.tube_heater: Voltage required to reach the rated heater power
Power requirement for the given saturation current
powergrid.component.property.vfet_gain.s: Controls the effect of gate voltage on channel current
powergrid.component.property.vfet_kg.sum: Perveance, controls channel current for a given voltage
powergrid.component.property.vfet_isat.s: Maximum current that can pass through the transistor before soft saturation clipping begins
powergrid.component.property.relay_thres: Voltage above which the relay triggers
powergrid.component.property.relay_curre: Current needed to trigger the relay (calculated from the threshold voltage)
powergrid.component.property.relay_polar: Whether the relay needs inverted current to reset itself
powergrid.component.property.gauge_equat: Equation to be applied to the measured voltage before displaying it
powergrid.component.property.regulator_t: Regulated voltage held by the regulator tube when it is lit and current is steady
powergrid.component.property.neon_tube_v: Voltage needed to light up the tube
powergrid.component.property.neon_tube_i: Minimum current needed to keep the tube lit
powergrid.component.property.neon_tube_v: Approximate voltage held by the tube once lit
powergrid.component.property.barretter_c: Constant current held by the tube
powergrid.component.property.varistor_vo: Voltage around which the varistor starts to conduct major current
powergrid.component.property.diode_vb.su: Reverse breakdown voltage of the diode
powergrid.component.property.current_fus: Current at which the fuse blows
powergrid.component.property.modular_dis: Minimum current required to actuate this component
